title: Record pane: on a grouped list or a kanban board the counter and ↓ ↑ are missing — step within the row's group or lane and name it in the tooltip
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4

Filing gate: ① follow-up owed by landed work — #27524 PR ④ (#28458, `55a1febca1`), ACCEPT 6547248636 item 6. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** A sales user working a grouped list (HotCRM's contact list is grouped by account) or a kanban board opens a record in the pane and has no 「3 / 21」 counter and no ↓ ↑: stepping to the next record means closing the pane and clicking the next row. The same user on an ungrouped list steps with ↓ ↑ or `j` / `k`. Target 7 of #27524 asks the counter's tooltip to name the group when the list was grouped or is a kanban column.

**Reach (measured).** PR #28458's evidence shot `04-contact-split-720.png` (commit `b0a817c91d`, HotCRM on that branch): a contact opened from the grouped contact list draws 「联系人 › John Smith」, ⤢ and ✕, and no counter.

**Reading (`origin/main` `bede9deaed`).** `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` ≈L5612: `const rowSequenceShown = paginate && surfaceDrawsFetchedRows;` — the list reports its shown rows (`onRowsChange`, #26679) only for the paged, ungrouped grid. A grouped grid and a kanban board report nothing, so the pane (`recordDrawerStack.tsx`) has no sibling set and `RecordTopBar` draws no counter.

**Wanted.**
1. A grouped grid reports its shown rows in display order with the group each row sits in; a kanban board reports the rows of a lane with the lane.
2. The pane's counter and ↓ ↑ step within the opened record's group / lane; the tooltip names it (「Acme Corporation 中第 1 条，共 3 条」), as Target 7 words it.
3. An ungrouped list keeps today's behaviour and tooltip.

**Tests.** Grouped grid: the counter and its group-named tooltip, ↓ to the next row of the same group, the last row of a group has no ↓. Kanban: the same within a lane. Control: ungrouped list unchanged. Ablation of the grouped report reds the grouped test.

**Reader who acts.** A `domain:ui` seat; surface `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` (and the kanban plugin's lane rows), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordDrawerStack.tsx` / `ObjectView.tsx` for the scope label, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx` untouched or tooltip-only. No spec change.

**Dedupe.** Searched "record pane counter stepper grouped list kanban group scope": 13 hits, none covers it (nearest #27057 closed, #26896 closed, #28212 open on kanban lanes in skills).

Links back: #27524 (Target 7), #26676, #26679, PR #28458.
